en-US.description: HFS is a web file server to run on your computer. Share folders or even a single file thanks to the virtual file system.
en-US.name: hfs
en-US.releaseNotes:
• admin：multilanguage #454
• admin/internet：support generation of wildcard certificate
• improved security
• upload："Pick folder" now available on mobile devices #1292
• customization：added beforeOptions and afterOptions #1295
• admin/logs/options：new "Spam URL regex"
• admin/options/upload：option `require_upload_approval_for_active_content` blocks inline serving of HTML/SVG uploaded by non-admins until approved
• [new APIs for plugins](https://github.com/rejetto/hfs/blob/4/dev-plugins.md#api-version-history)
• other minor improvements

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/rejetto/hfs/compare/v3.3.3...v3.4.0
